battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units in the first battle round.

regimentAbilities.name: Covered in Mud
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of First Battle Round
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability. In this battle, that unit is not visible to enemy models that are more than 12 inches away from it.

regimentAbilities.name: Kunnin' Plan
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general. If that unit uses a Retreat ability this turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on it and it can still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.

enhancements.name: Mork's Eye Pebble
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: In the next shooting phase, friendly units have Ward (5+) while they are wholly within 12 inches of your general.

enhancements.name: Egomaniak
enhancements.effect: If any other friendly units are within your general's combat range, before you allocate a damage point to your general, roll a dice. On a 4+, you must allocate that damage point to one of those units instead.

enhancements.name: Eye-biter Ash
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general and roll a dice. On a 1-4, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that unit for the rest of the phase. On a 5+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that unit for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Blood Rites
battleTraits.effect: At the start of each battle round, all friendly units gain the Blood Rites passive ability that corresponds to the current battle round number (units keep all Blood Rites abilities gained in previous battle rounds). Round 1 Quickening Bloodlust: Add 1 to run rolls for this unit. Round 2 Headlong Fury: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit. Round 3 Zealot's Rage: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit. Round 4 Slaughterer's Strength: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by this unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Murderous Epiphany
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: All friendly units gain the Blood Rites passive ability they would have gained at the start of the next battle round (they keep this ability for the rest of the battle, but they do not gain it for a second time at the start of the next battle round).

regimentAbilities.name: Blessing of Khaine
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general. You cannot pick your general. Add 1 to ward rolls for that unit this phase.

enhancements.name: Bathed in Blood
enhancements.effect: Each time a model is slain by your general, Heal (1) your general.

enhancements.name: Fuelled by Revenge
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Blood Stalkers units while they are wholly within 12 inches of your general.

enhancements.name: Flask of Shademist
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units while they are wholly within 12 inches of your general.

enhancements.name: Zealous Orator
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 9 inches of your general that is not in combat. Roll a dice for each slain model from that unit. For each 5+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

battleTraits.name: Hidden Hunters
battleTraits.effect: Your 2 Hunters of Huanchi units and the Spawn of Chotec are not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the third battle round onwards, they can use Chameleon Ambush: set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Vengeance of Azyr
battleTraits.effect: Pick each enemy unit in combat with a friendly Saurus unit to be the targets. Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

regimentAbilities.name: Scaled Aegis
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Saurus unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has Ward (6+) until the start of your next turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Followers of Huanchi
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Skink unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target's ranged weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn, including Companion weapons.

enhancements.name: Instinctive Commander
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general and not in combat to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

enhancements.name: Savage Mauling
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target. Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Venomite Swarm
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target. If your general's Venomites token is on the battlefield, roll a D3. On a 1, remove that token from the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

enhancements.name: Blessed by the Old Ones
enhancements.effect: Your general must use this ability if it has been destroyed. Roll a dice. On a 2+, you can set up a replacement unit with 1 Sunblood model anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Cycle of Corruption
battleTraits.effect: If it is the first battle round, roll a dice to determine which Cycle ability can be used this battle round (reroll 5s and 6s). Otherwise the next Cycle ability in sequence is used. 1 Numberless Pests: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units. 2 Plague of Misery: While enemy units are within 6 inches of any friendly units, they cannot use abilities that heal or return slain models. 3 Burgeoning Filth: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly units. 4 Nauseous Revulsion: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Corruption of the Land
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a terrain feature, then roll a dice for each enemy unit within 3 inches of that terrain feature. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Putrefied Ground
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: subtract 1 from the Move characteristic of enemy units; subtract 1 from run rolls for enemy units.

enhancements.name: Unnatural Vitality
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (4+).

enhancements.name: Subcutaneous Suppuration
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target your general.

enhancements.name: Gaseous Emanation
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within your general's combat range to be the target. The target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Overripe Death's Heads
enhancements.effect: If your general is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 7 inches of them to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: Boulder Basher
battleTraits.effect: Mobs of Stone Lobbas are led by Boulder Bashers. Add the Hero keyword to your general's warscroll and remove the Reinforcements keyword.

battleTraits.name: Bowled Over
battleTraits.effect: Pick an enemy unit that was allocated any damage points by a friendly unit's shooting attacks this turn to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent makes a charge roll for the target, they must change the highest D6 to match the lowest D6.

battleTraits.name: Close One Eye!
battleTraits.effect: Pick your general to use this ability, then pick another friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of them to be the target. Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Surly Sorts
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Greedy and Grabby
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly units.

enhancements.name: 'Ard 'Ead
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with your general's 'Eadbutt for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Hungry Gobbler
enhancements.effect: If any enemy models were slain by your general's combat attacks this turn, Heal (D3) your general.

enhancements.name: Humongous Strides
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for your general.

enhancements.name: Lucky Rock
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of your general's Hurlin' Rocks for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Nomadic Warriors
battleTraits.effect: Your unit of Gluttons with 3 models and 1 of your Maulbeast Cavalry units are not set up during deployment. From the third battle round onwards they can use More Ogors, My Lord!: set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield so that every model is within 1 inch of a battlefield edge and more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Scoff Down Fresh Flesh
battleTraits.effect: If an enemy unit was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly unit that used a Fight ability this turn. Pick 1 effect for the rest of the battle: Raw and Bloody Flesh: Add 1 to hit rolls for that unit's combat attacks if it charged in the same turn. Exotic Giblets: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit's combat attacks. Steaming Brains: Add 3 to that unit's control score.

regimentAbilities.name: Brutish Barging
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to be the target. The target can move up to 2D6 inches. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of that move but cannot end that move in combat.

regimentAbilities.name: Blinding Dust Clouds
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units that were set up in the same turn.

enhancements.name: Lungburster
enhancements.effect: When making run rolls for friendly units wholly within 9 inches of your general, if you roll a 1-3, you can use a value of 4 instead.

enhancements.name: Deathcheater
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (6+) while they are more than 3 inches from all other friendly units.

enhancements.name: Gristlegobbler
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
enhancements.effect: Pick each enemy unit in combat with your general to be the targets. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target. Then, Heal (3) your general.

enhancements.name: Wallwrecker
enhancements.effect: Your general can pass across terrain features as if they had Fly.

battleTraits.name: Wot? No Meat!?
battleTraits.effect: Your general's Butcher's Cauldron starts the battle empty.

battleTraits.name: Chuck 'Em in the Pot
battleTraits.effect: You must use this ability if an enemy unit was destroyed this turn. Your general's Butcher's Cauldron becomes full.

battleTraits.name: From Out the Caverns
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect: Your Gorger Mawpack is not set up during deployment. From the second battle round onwards they can use Frenzied Hunters: set up this unit within 1 inch of a battlefield edge and more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Dish Testers
regimentAbilities.trigger: Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: If your general's Butcher's Cauldron is full, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of them to be the target. Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn. Then, your general's Butcher's Cauldron becomes empty.

regimentAbilities.name: Eager Procurers
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: While your general's Butcher's Cauldron is empty, add 2 inches to the Move characteristic of friendly units while they are wholly within 12 inches of your general.

enhancements.name: Generous Portions
enhancements.effect: If your general's Butcher's Cauldron is full, Heal (1) each visible friendly unit wholly within 9 inches of your general.

enhancements.name: Disgusting Eater
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a Charge ability for a visible enemy unit within 12 inches of this unit
enhancements.effect: Subtract D3 from the charge roll. If your general's Butcher's Cauldron is full, you can subtract 3 instead, but if you do so their Butcher's Cauldron becomes empty after that Charge ability has been resolved.

enhancements.name: Hunger Pangs
enhancements.effect: Each friendly unit that is not in combat can move up to D3 inches. Friendly units that are not in combat and are wholly within 9 inches of your general while their Butcher's Cauldron is empty can move up to D6 inches instead. They cannot end those moves in combat.

enhancements.name: Well-stocked Larder
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: Your general's Butcher's Cauldron becomes full.

battleTraits.name: Temptations of Slaanesh
battleTraits.effect: You receive 6 temptation dice at the start of the battle round. Each time your opponent makes a failed hit, wound or save roll, you can offer them a temptation dice. If accepted, that roll is replaced with a 6. Each acceptance gains D6 depravity points; each rejection inflicts D3 mortal damage on that unit. Cumulative DP abilities: 12+ Tantalising Torment (Run then Charge); 18+ Sadistic Spite (melee Crit Mortal); 24+ Oblivious Indulgence (Ward 5+).

regimentAbilities.name: Unparalleled Speed
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability. That unit has Strike-first this phase.

regimentAbilities.name: Locus of Diversion
regimentAbilities.trigger: Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use a Retreat ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.

enhancements.name: Sceptre of Domination
enhancements.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with your general. On a 5+, that unit has Strike-last this phase.

enhancements.name: Cacophonic Choir
enhancements.effect: Make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 6+, make a cacophony roll of D6. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 6 inches of your general that has a Control characteristic less than the cacophony roll.

enhancements.name: Pendant of Slaanesh
enhancements.effect: Heal (D3) your general.

enhancements.name: Twisted Mirror
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Turn, Your Shooting Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 9 inches of your general and roll a dice. On a 4+, subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit until the start of your next turn.

battleTraits.name: Favour Most Fickle
battleTraits.effect: Effects based on friendly units on the battlefield (not cumulative): 5+: +2 Control; 4: +1 hit and wound for combat including Companion; 3: +1 run and charge; 2: Ward (5+); 1: +2 Attacks to melee including Companion.

battleTraits.name: Bringers of Degradation
battleTraits.effect: When alternating Fight abilities, when it is your turn you can pick 2 friendly Daemonettes units instead of 1.

regimentAbilities.name: Daemonic Onslaught
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Seekers or Fiends unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target. The target can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

regimentAbilities.name: Irresistible Soul-musk
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly Seekers or Fiends unit wholly within 12 inches of your general. Remove the target and set it up again more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: High Courtiers
enhancements.effect: While your general is wholly within the combat range of a friendly Daemonettes unit, both units have Ward (5+).

enhancements.name: Twisted Grace
enhancements.effect: When your general makes a pile-in move, if they charged in the same turn, add D6 inches to the distance they can move.

enhancements.name: Excess of Violence
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general. The target's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) until the start of your next turn.

battleTraits.name: Fierce Zealots
battleTraits.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Freeguild Steelhelms units.

battleTraits.name: Lady of the Wheel
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly model is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to that model's Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

battleTraits.name: Shadowy Spymaster
battleTraits.effect: Your Whisperblade is not set up during deployment. From the second battle round onwards it can use Sudden Ambush: set up this unit within 6 inches of an enemy unit and not in combat.

regimentAbilities.name: Stand Fast, Comrades
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly non-Hero unit wholly within 12 inches of your general. The target has Ward (4+) until the start of the next battle round.

regimentAbilities.name: Fervent Rush
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability. This unit can use Charge abilities this turn even if it used a Run ability in the same turn.

enhancements.name: Step to It!
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a Run ability for a non-Hero unit wholly within 12 inches of your general
enhancements.effect: Do not make a run roll. Instead, add 6 inches to that non-Hero unit's Move characteristic for that Run ability.

enhancements.name: Ardent Demand
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly non-Hero unit wholly within 12 inches of your general. Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Devout Commander
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and the Rend characteristic of your general's Master-forged Weapon.

battleTraits.name: Ethereal
battleTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly units.

battleTraits.name: Spectral Procession
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.effect: 1 of your Bladegheist Revenants units and 1 of your Dreadscythe Harridans units start the battle in reserve. From the second battle round onwards use Cackling Arrival: pick 1 of your units in reserve and set it up anywhere more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Discorporate
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Mounting Dread
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with the target.

enhancements.name: Deathly Possessor
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy Hero within 12 inches of your general to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target's combat range to be the victim. Roll a D3. On a 2+, pick one: inflict mortal damage on the target equal to the roll, or on the victim equal to the roll.

enhancements.name: Tales of Horror
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy Infantry or Cavalry unit within 6 inches of your general. For the rest of the battle, if the target is replaced using Call for Reinforcements, halve the number of models in the replacement unit, rounding up.

enhancements.name: Spectral Howl
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 12 inches of your general. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

enhancements.name: Unholy Visage
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6 inches of your general. Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target must immediately use a Retreat ability as if it were the enemy movement phase.

battleTraits.name: Diseased
battleTraits.effect: Each time an attack made by a friendly model scores a critical hit, you receive 1 disease point, to a maximum of 7.

battleTraits.name: The Infectious Hosts
battleTraits.effect: One of your Pusgoyle Blightlords and one of your Plaguebearers units are not set up during deployment. From the third battle round onwards they can use Daemonic Summoning: set up this unit anywhere more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Nurgle's Embrace
battleTraits.effect: Spend any number of your disease points. For each disease point spent, pick an enemy unit in combat with any of your units and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit (you can pick the same enemy unit more than once).

regimentAbilities.name: Locus of Fecundity
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Phase, Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit. Heal (D3) that unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Infested with Wonders
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Each time a friendly model is slain, before it is removed from play, you can pick an enemy unit within 1 inch of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

enhancements.name: Gift of Febrile Frenzy
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 7 inches of your general.

enhancements.name: Gardener of Nurgle
enhancements.effect: If your general is contesting an objective not contested by any enemy models, roll a dice. On a 3+, that objective is desecrated. Friendly units have Ward (4+) while contesting a desecrated objective. If your opponent gains control of it, it is no longer desecrated.

enhancements.name: Pestilent Breath
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 7 inches of your general and roll a dice for each model in that unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

enhancements.name: Summoner of Plaguebearers
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly Plaguebearers unit wholly within 14 inches of your general. Return 1 slain model to that unit.

battleTraits.name: The Hunger
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly Vampire unit uses a Fight ability, after all of its attacks have been resolved, Heal (X) that Vampire unit where X is the number of damage points allocated by those attacks.

battleTraits.name: Death's Descent
battleTraits.effect: Your Vargheists unit is not set up during deployment. From the third battle round onwards they can use Swoop Down: set up this unit anywhere more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Cloud of Bats
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Endless Legions
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Deathrattle Skeletons unit that has been destroyed. You can set up a replacement unit with D6+4 models anywhere more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: Ruinous Chargers
enhancements.effect: Pick your Blood Knights unit to use this ability if it charged this turn. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit it passed across during that Charge ability.

enhancements.name: Grave-sand Shard
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the Skeleton Legion ability for a unit within 9 inches of your general
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to each legion roll made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Aura of Night
enhancements.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target your general.

enhancements.name: Spirit Gale
enhancements.effect: Make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 7+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit on the battlefield.

battleTraits.name: Fortify Position
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly Castelite units if they did not use a Move ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Respected Leader
battleTraits.effect: Friendly Wildercorps Hunters units gain the Reinforcements keyword.

regimentAbilities.name: Well Provisioned
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-Hero unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit's shooting attacks for the rest of the phase.

regimentAbilities.name: Adept Tactician
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick 2 friendly Freeguild Fusiliers units that have been destroyed and have not already been replaced. Set up a single replacement Freeguild Fusiliers unit with 10 models more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: Brace!
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (5+).

enhancements.name: Shield Bash
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy Infantry, War Machine or Cavalry unit in combat with your general. Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target must immediately use the Retreat ability as if it were the enemy movement phase.

enhancements.name: Point-blank Volley
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Turn, Enemy Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: The Unquiet Dead
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.effect: One of your Deathrattle Skeletons units is not set up during the deployment phase. From the third battle round onwards, it can use The Rising Dead: set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3 inches of a battlefield edge and more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Aura of Antiquity
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly units to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Overwhelming Hordes
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly non-Hero units that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Deathmarch
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-Hero unit that is not in combat to be the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 inch to the target's Move characteristic and add 3 to its control score.

enhancements.name: Shyishan Blade
enhancements.effect: The Rend characteristic of your general's Baleful Tomb Blade is 2.

enhancements.name: Stolen Animus
enhancements.effect: Each time your general scores a critical hit, Heal (2) your general after the Attack ability has been resolved.

enhancements.name: Propelled by Hate
enhancements.effect: Pick another friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target. You can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Soul-Drain Pendant
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: On the Mawpath
battleTraits.effect: Your Ironblaster, Mournfang Pack and 1 unit of Ogor Gluttons are not set up during the deployment phase. From the third battle round onwards they can use Bellowing Arrival: set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield, within 1 inch of a battlefield edge and more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Pulverising Girth
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Phase, Any Charge Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick any number of friendly units that charged this phase. For each of those units, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Bred for Toughness
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to the Health characteristic of your Ironblaster and your Mournfang Pack unit.

enhancements.name: Longstrider
enhancements.effect: Your general has a Move characteristic of 8 inches instead of 6 inches.

enhancements.name: Booming Roar
enhancements.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units this phase while they are within 9 inches of your general.

enhancements.name: Flask of Stonehorn Blood
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability and targeted your general
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (3+) this phase.

enhancements.name: Blubbergrub
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick either your Ironblaster or your Mournfang Pack unit if it is within your general's combat range. Heal (D6) that unit.

battleTraits.name: The Quarry
battleTraits.effect: If no enemy units are the quarry, pick an enemy unit to be the quarry (you can pick an enemy unit in reserve).

battleTraits.name: Blood-drenched
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that slew any enemy models using a Fight ability this turn to be the target. For the rest of the battle, the target's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

regimentAbilities.name: The Scent of Blood
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Savagery Upon Savagery
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons. If the target is a Hero, add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Sustained by Gore
enhancements.effect: Heal (D3) your general.

enhancements.name: Evasive Hunter
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks that target your general.

enhancements.name: Killing Pounce
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for your general, you can roll an additional dice, to a maximum of 3, but if you do, they must finish that charge in combat with the quarry.

enhancements.name: Furious Bites
enhancements.effect: If your general is in combat with the quarry, inflict D3 mortal damage on the quarry.

battleTraits.name: Tides of Death
battleTraits.effect: In each battle round, all friendly units have the Tides of Death passive ability that corresponds to the current battle round number. Round 1 Low Tide: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit. Round 2 Flood Tide: This unit can use a Run ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn. Round 3 High Tide: This unit has Strike-first. Round 4 Ebb Tide: This unit can use a Retreat ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Way of the Cresting Wave
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Namarti Thralls units that charged in the same turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Mind Flare
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general. Until the end of the phase, attacks made by that unit only score hits on unmodified hit rolls of 6.

regimentAbilities.name: Ethersea Predators
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Cavalry unit that used a Fight ability this turn. Heal (D3) that unit.

enhancements.name: Arch-Ritualist
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to rolls for your general's 'Ritual of the Creeping Mist' ability.

enhancements.name: Delicious Morsels
enhancements.effect: Heal (1) each friendly Cavalry unit within your general's combat range.

enhancements.name: Steelshell Armour
enhancements.effect: Ignore all modifiers to save rolls for your general (positive and negative).

battleTraits.name: The Officar's Order
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect: Pick a battle tactic card in your hand and place it face-down separately next to your other battle tactic cards. The information on it is still hidden from your opponent but make it clear which card is separate. The card stays separate until you use the command on it or score the battle tactic on it as described below. When you use the command on that card, it is not discarded but returns to your hand. Your opponent can check the information on it before it returns to your hand. The card goes back to being a normal battle tactic card, with the exception that you cannot use the command on it in the same phase it went back into your hand. If you did not use the command on the card you separated, you can still score the battle tactic on it at the end of your turn as normal if you met its conditions. If you do so, discard it as normal. If you neither used the command nor scored the battle tactic on the card, it automatically returns to your hand at the end of your turn.

regimentAbilities.name: For Sigmar, Charge!
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Use this ability before any Charge abilities are used this phase. Friendly Cavalry units that charge this phase have Strike-first this turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Ironweld Discipline
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Enemy Shooting Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick your Ironweld Great Cannon to use this ability. It can use the 'Shoot' ability as if it were your shooting phase.

enhancements.name: Flask of Lethisian Darkwater
enhancements.effect: Heal (D6) your general.

enhancements.name: Glimmering
enhancements.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 save roll made for your general.

enhancements.name: Brazier of Holy Flame
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly Freeguild Steelhelms unit within your general's combat range. You can return up to D3 slain models to that unit.

enhancements.name: Heirloom Blade
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's Master-forged Longsword.

battleTraits.name: The Lurking Vermintide
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target. The target unit is set up in reserve in the tunnels below. Units in the tunnels below that have not used the 'Gnawhole Ambush' ability by the end of the third battle round are destroyed.

battleTraits.name: Gnawhole Ambush
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is in the tunnels below to use this ability. Set up that unit wholly within 6 inches of a corner of the battlefield and more than 9 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Warpstone-Laced Bullets
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a ranged weapon a friendly unit is armed with. That weapon has Crit (Mortal) this phase.

regimentAbilities.name: Too Quick to Hit-Hit
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly units when they use Retreat abilities.

enhancements.name: Lead the Seething Horde
enhancements.trigger: Reaction: You declared the 'Call for Reinforcements' ability
enhancements.effect: Instead of using the set-up instructions in the 'Call for Reinforcements' ability, the replacement unit can be set up wholly within 13 inches of this unit and not in combat.

enhancements.name: Skryre Connections
enhancements.effect: Your general's Ratling Pistol has an Attacks characteristic of 2D6 instead of D6.

enhancements.name: Warpstone Charm
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units in combat with your general.

enhancements.name: Cloak of Stitched Victories
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (5+).

battleTraits.name: Oaths of Darkness
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: You can reveal 1 battle tactic card in your hand to your opponent. If you do so, that battle tactic card becomes your oath for the rest of the turn. While this battle tactic card is your oath, you can still use the command on it, or attempt to score the battle tactic on it, as normal. If you score the battle tactic on your oath this turn, your oath is fulfilled. Instead of discarding the card, it is placed to one side but you can still use the command on it. Once you do so, the card is discarded as normal. Fulfilled oaths placed to one side in this way do not count towards the 3 battle tactic cards you can have in your hand. If you use the command on your oath before it is scored, it is discarded as normal. At the end of the turn, if the oath is still in your hand and that oath has not been fulfilled, it ceases to be your oath.

regimentAbilities.name: Rage of Arkhar
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons. This does not affect Companion weapons.

regimentAbilities.name: Fearless Invaders
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target. If the target uses a Retreat ability this turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on it and it can still use Charge abilities later in the turn.

enhancements.name: Bloodthirsty Blade
enhancements.effect: The Rend characteristic of your general's Rune-etched Axe is 2.

enhancements.name: Godshadow Talisman
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (4+).

enhancements.name: Champion of Raids
enhancements.effect: Pick another friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target. The target can re-roll charge rolls for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Fell Ritualist
enhancements.effect: Each time you draw battle tactic cards, if your general is on the battlefield, you can choose to draw 1 additional battle tactic card, then put 1 of your battle tactic cards in your hand back at the bottom of your battle tactic deck.

battleTraits.name: Better Late Than Never
battleTraits.effect: A unit of Ironguts with 4 models is not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, in the third battle round, that unit can use Let's Get Stuck In: set up this unit wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6 inches of the battlefield edge, and not in combat.

regimentAbilities.name: It's a Hard Life
regimentAbilities.trigger: Any Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Gnoblars unit within your general's combat range to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+: Heal (X) your general where X is an amount equal to the roll; 1 model in that Gnoblars unit is slain.

regimentAbilities.name: Frenzied Artillery
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: If the unmodified charge roll for a friendly Gnoblar Scraplauncher is 6+, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's Companion weapons for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Savage Instincts
enhancements.trigger: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for your general
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within your general's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by your general has been resolved.

enhancements.name: Nasty Trap
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 12 inches of your general to be the target. Give the target your general's Trap token. While the target has a Trap token, each time the target is picked to use a Move or Charge ability, roll a dice. On a 4+, that Move or Charge ability has no effect and the target's Trap token is removed.

enhancements.name: Massive Bulk
enhancements.effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of your general.

enhancements.name: Veteran Hunter
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 12 inches of your general to be the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's combat attacks that target that unit.

battleTraits.name: Royal Imperative
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.effect: You can only use this ability in the third battle round. Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round: Into Them! — Friendly units have Strike-first. Strike Sure — Friendly units' melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

regimentAbilities.name: The Spear of Asphoren
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability. Add 1 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.

regimentAbilities.name: The Shield of Ulchiss
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability. For the rest of the turn, each time that unit uses a Retreat ability, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

enhancements.name: Shimmering Amulet
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (5+).

enhancements.name: Voltaic Charge
enhancements.effect: Your general's Akhelian Royal Weapons have Charge (+1 Damage).

enhancements.name: Soul Stealer
enhancements.effect: If your general is in combat, Heal (D3) your general.

enhancements.name: Dutiful Souls
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target. You can return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target is an Infantry unit, you can return D3 slain models to it instead.

battleTraits.name: Squigalanche
battleTraits.effect: One of your units of Squig Hoppers is not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the third battle round onwards, they can use this ability: Set up this unit wholly within your territory, wholly within 3 inches of a battlefield edge and more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Under the Light of the Bad Moon
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
battleTraits.effect: Pick a territory (either friendly territory or enemy territory) to be under the Light of the Bad Moon. If both players can use this ability, the players roll off and the winner picks a territory to be under the Light of the Bad Moon. The territory picked remains under the Light of the Bad Moon in the first and second battle rounds. In the third and fourth battle rounds, the other territory is under the Light of the Bad Moon. While a friendly unit is wholly within the territory that is under the Light of the Bad Moon, the appropriate effect below applies to it: Frothing Zealots: If the unit is a Moonclan Stabbas unit, add 3 to its control score. Lunar Squigs: If the unit is a Squig Hoppers unit, no mortal damage is inflicted on it when it uses Retreat abilities. Moonlit Hide: If the unit is a Rockgut Troggoths unit, add 1 to save rolls for it.

regimentAbilities.name: The Lunatic Hordes
regimentAbilities.trigger: Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Moonclan Stabbas unit to use this ability. You can return up to D3 slain models to that unit.

regimentAbilities.name: The Hand of Gork
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability. Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9 inches from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: Fight Another Day
enhancements.effect: Pick your general to use this ability if they used a Fight ability this turn. Your general can make a 2D6 inch move but cannot end that move in combat.

enhancements.name: Hallucinogenic Fungus Brew
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (4+) in the first battle round, Ward (5+) in the second battle round, and Ward (6+) in the third and fourth battle rounds.

enhancements.name: The Clammy Cowl
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target your general.

enhancements.name: Nightshade Mushroom
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly unit within your general's combat range. That unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks in the next shooting phase.

battleTraits.name: Strike and Fade
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that used a Fight ability this turn and is within 3 inches of any terrain features, then roll a dice. On a 2+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again so that each model in the unit is within 3 inches of any terrain features and more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Ley Lines
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: Heal (1) each friendly unit that is within 3 inches of any terrain features.

regimentAbilities.name: Vengeful Spirits of the Land
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick an enemy unit that is contesting an objective and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Walkers of the Hidden Paths
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is within 3 inches of any terrain features and not in combat. Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6 inches from all enemy units. That unit cannot use Move abilities for the rest of the phase.

enhancements.name: Gnarled Warrior
enhancements.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for your general.

enhancements.name: Treesong
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 7+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target unit's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Seed of Rebirth
enhancements.effect: If your general would be destroyed, before removing them from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, your general is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on them have no effect. Then, Heal (1) your general. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

enhancements.name: Regrowth
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18 inches of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 5+, Heal (D6) the target.

battleTraits.name: Eye of the Gods
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: Pick one of the following friendly units to use this ability: a unit that is contesting an objective not controlled by your opponent and is not in combat; or a unit that destroyed an enemy unit this turn. Roll once on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit. That unit gains the Eye of the Gods passive ability that corresponds to the roll (the unit keeps all Eye of the Gods abilities gained in previous turns). If the same unit gains the same ability more than once in the battle, the effects are not cumulative. D6: 1 Snubbed by the Gods — No effect. 2 Ward of Tzeentch — This unit has Ward (6+). 3 Grace of Slaanesh — Add 1 to run rolls for this unit. 4 Blessing of Nurgle — Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit. 5 Fury of Khorne — Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons. 6 Champion of Chaos — Pick any ability from the table.

regimentAbilities.name: The Dread Banner
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Chaos Warriors or Chaos Knights unit. You can immediately roll on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Fierce Conquerors
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Chaos Warriors units.

enhancements.name: Mark of Khorne
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's melee weapons if they charged in the same turn.

enhancements.name: Mark of Slaanesh
enhancements.effect: Your general has Strike-first.

enhancements.name: Mark of Tzeentch
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly unit on the battlefield. You cannot pick your general. Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6 inches of your general and more than 6 inches from all enemy units. It cannot use Move abilities for the rest of the phase.

enhancements.name: Mark of Nurgle
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target your general.

battleTraits.name: Noble Deeds
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly Hero uses a Fight ability, after its attacks have been resolved, give that Hero a number of noble deeds points equal to the number of damage points allocated by that ability. Each Hero can have a maximum of 6 noble deeds points at any time.

battleTraits.name: Feeding Frenzy
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 12 inches of any friendly Heroes that have 6 noble deeds points.

battleTraits.name: Summon Loyal Subjects
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly Hero with any noble deeds points to use this ability. Spend any number of that Hero's noble deeds points as follows: Pick a friendly Cryptguard unit within 9 inches of this unit and spend 1 noble deeds point to return 1 model to that unit. Pick a friendly Morbheg Knights unit within 9 inches of this unit and spend 2 noble deeds points to return 1 model to that unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Crusading Army
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units.

regimentAbilities.name: Defenders of the Realm
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly units that are contesting an objective you control.

enhancements.name: Ulguan Cloak
enhancements.effect: Your general is not visible to enemy models that are more than 12 inches away from them.

enhancements.name: Rousing Oration
enhancements.effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general. Do not roll a dice for your general. For each 5+, give 1 noble deeds point to your general.

enhancements.name: Blood-River Chalice
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
enhancements.effect: Heal (2D3) your general.

enhancements.name: Crimson Victuals
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18 inches of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, if your Cryptguard unit is within 6 inches of the target, you can return 1 slain model to your Cryptguard unit for each damage point allocated by this ability.

battleTraits.name: Delusions and Madness
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round. If it is the first battle round, pick a Delusion. Otherwise, make a delusion roll by rolling a D6. On a 1-3, you must pick a different Delusion to the one you picked last time. On a 4+, you must pick the same Delusion as last time. For the rest of the battle round, you believe the Delusion you picked.

battleTraits.name: Delusion of the Great Feast
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: If you believe this Delusion, pick each friendly unit on the battlefield to be the targets. Heal (1) each target. If the target is a Serfs unit, return D3 slain models to it instead.

battleTraits.name: Delusion of the Knightly Host
battleTraits.effect: While you believe this Delusion, if the unmodified charge roll for a friendly Hero or Knights unit is 8+, add 1 to hit rolls for that unit's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Delusion of the Sentinel
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: While you believe this Delusion, add 1 to ward rolls for friendly units while each model in the unit is contesting an objective.

regimentAbilities.name: Delusion of the Hunter
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: While you believe this Delusion, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units while no models in the unit are contesting an objective.

enhancements.name: Almost Lucid
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the 'Delusions and Madness' ability
enhancements.effect: You can re-roll the delusion roll.

enhancements.name: A Worthy Challenge
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit that started the battle with 3 or fewer models and is in combat with your general to be the target. Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse your general's challenge. If they accept, for the rest of the phase, when your general and the target are picked to use a Fight ability, all of their attacks must target each other. If they refuse, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the phase.

enhancements.name: Companion of the Hunt
enhancements.effect: If your general is not in combat, they can move 3 inches. They cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

enhancements.name: Choirmaster
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6 inches of your general to be the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of friendly units' ranged weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.

battleTraits.name: Masters of Destiny
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
battleTraits.effect: Roll 9 dice and put them to one side. These are your destiny dice. During the battle, instead of rolling the dice for 1 of the rolls from the list below, you can pick one of your destiny dice and use it as the roll. Once a destiny dice has been used, it is discarded. If you want to replace a roll that uses more than one D6, you must use the same number of destiny dice (e.g. you would need to use 2 destiny dice in place of a 2D6 casting roll). Rolls that are replaced count as unmodified rolls and cannot be re-rolled or modified unless noted. The following rolls can be replaced with destiny dice: Casting rolls; Run rolls; Charge rolls; Hit rolls; Wound rolls; Save rolls – you must still modify the roll by the Rend characteristic of the attacking weapon.

regimentAbilities.name: Eternal Conflagration
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly Flamers of Tzeentch units.

regimentAbilities.name: Transient Forms
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Roll a dice each time a friendly Kairic Acolytes model is slain in the combat phase. On a 4+, you can return 1 slain model to a friendly Tzaangors unit within 9 inches of the slain model.

enhancements.name: Daemonheart
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 1 inch of your general. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the number of the current battle round.

enhancements.name: Timeslip Pendant
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 9 inches of your general. That unit has Strike-last this phase.

enhancements.name: Shield of Fate
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18 inches of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 6+, until the start of your next turn, that unit has Ward (6+). If that unit already has a ward save, add 1 to ward rolls for that unit until the start of your next turn instead.

enhancements.name: Glimpse the Future
enhancements.effect: If you have fewer than 6 destiny dice, make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 7+, you can roll a dice and add it to your destiny dice.

battleTraits.name: Facets of War
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round. Pick 1 Facet of War ability. That Facet of War ability can be used this battle round but the other two cannot.

battleTraits.name: Lightning Reactions
battleTraits.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a Fight ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 units instead of 1. Resolve the second Fight ability immediately after the first.

battleTraits.name: Power of Hysh
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit. Roll a dice. On a 2+, until the start of your next turn, attacks made by that unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

battleTraits.name: Shining Company
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability
battleTraits.effect: Used By: A friendly unit targeted by that Attack ability and that has not made a pile-in move this turn. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the attacks that target that friendly unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Arcane Prowess
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for your general.

regimentAbilities.name: Heightened Reflexes
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly units that use a Fight ability immediately after another friendly unit because of the 'Lightning Reactions' ability, until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Overwhelming Heat
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24 inches of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 7+, halve the Move characteristic of that unit until the start of your next turn and roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds that unit's Save characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

enhancements.name: Protection of Hysh
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 7+, the target has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Waystone
enhancements.effect: Remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: Speed of Hysh
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18 inches of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 5+, double the Move characteristic of that unit until the start of your next turn.

battleTraits.name: The Blood Tithe
battleTraits.effect: Each time a unit is destroyed during the battle, you receive 1 blood tithe point.

battleTraits.name: Favoured of Khorne
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, you receive 1 blood tithe point.

battleTraits.name: Murderlust
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 blood tithe point and pick up to D3 friendly units. Each of those units can move D6 inches (roll for each).

battleTraits.name: Heads Must Roll
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Spend 3 blood tithe points and pick up to 3 friendly units. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of those units' melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Resanguination
regimentAbilities.trigger: Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 16 inches of your general, then make a chanting roll of D6. On a 3+, Heal (D3) that unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Unholy Flames
regimentAbilities.trigger: Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 16 inches of your general, then make a chanting roll of D6. On a 4+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Headhunter
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy Hero in combat with your general. Your general has Strike-first this phase, but all attacks made by them this phase must target that enemy Hero.

enhancements.name: Blood-woken Runes
enhancements.effect: Friendly units have Ward (5+) if they have used a Fight ability in the same phase.

enhancements.name: The Crimson Plate
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (5+).

battleTraits.name: Gunhauler Escort
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Kharadron Overlords Infantry units while they are wholly within 6 inches of a friendly Grundstok Gunhauler.

battleTraits.name: Propeller Downdraught
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 9 inches of a friendly Grundstok Gunhauler.

regimentAbilities.name: Rapid Relocation
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit with Fly to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units. The target cannot use Charge abilities this turn.

enhancements.name: Celestium-Burst Bomblets
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Prospector and Pioneer
enhancements.effect: Add 2 to your general's control score.

enhancements.name: Emergency Fuel Injection Pods
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Your general has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Extraction Fail-Safes
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from the number of damage points inflicted on this unit when it uses a Retreat ability.

battleTraits.name: Harness Daemonic Power
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: You must use this ability at the start of each of your hero phases. Remove all daemonic power points from each friendly unit. Then, gain a number of daemonic power points equal to the current battle round number plus 1. Then, allocate your daemonic power points to friendly units. Each unit can have a maximum of 3 daemonic power points. Then, all unallocated daemonic power points are lost. Designer's Note: Your units have abilities that become more powerful depending on how many daemonic power points they have. We recommend using coloured dice to track the number of points each unit has.

regimentAbilities.name: Grinding Advance
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly Infernal Cohort units to be the targets. Each target can immediately move up to 3 inches but cannot use Charge abilities in the first battle round.

regimentAbilities.name: Suppressive Bombardment
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn, Your Shooting Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick an enemy Infantry unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn as a result of shooting attacks made by a friendly Tormentor Bombard to be the target. Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

enhancements.name: Scroll of Petrification
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, your general has Ward (2+) but cannot use abilities or be picked to be the target of friendly abilities.

enhancements.name: Chalice of Darkness
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12 inches of your general to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

enhancements.name: Talisman of Obsidian
enhancements.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to your general in each phase.

enhancements.name: Amulet of Burning Hate
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, your general's attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

battleTraits.name: Storm Brewing
battleTraits.effect: Pick a battlefield edge to be the target. That battlefield edge is leeward. For the rest of the battle, each time a friendly Ride the Hurricane ability is used, after that ability has been resolved, change the leeward battlefield edge to the next edge clockwise.

battleTraits.name: Gale Force
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an Attack ability
battleTraits.effect: Used By: The unit using that Attack ability. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that Attack ability if the target of that ability is closer to the leeward battlefield edge than the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: Pulled by the Winds
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to be the target. The target can move D6 inches but must end that move closer to the leeward battlefield edge. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

regimentAbilities.name: Lifted Debris
regimentAbilities.trigger: Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick an enemy unit that is closer to the leeward battlefield edge than the large terrain feature within friendly territory to be the target. Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

regimentAbilities.name: Roaring Headwind
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick an enemy unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a Move ability, it must end that move closer to the leeward battlefield edge.

regimentAbilities.name: Wind Whisperer
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a battlefield edge to be the target. Change the leeward battlefield edge to the target battlefield edge.

enhancements.name: Temple Guardians
enhancements.effect: While any friendly Infantry units are within your general's combat range, both your general and those Infantry units have Ward (5+).

enhancements.name: Curved Shots
enhancements.effect: You can measure the range and visibility of your general's shooting attacks from any point on the leeward battlefield edge.

enhancements.name: Scattered to the Winds
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from the control scores of enemy units within 6 inches of your general for each friendly Ride the Hurricane ability used this battle round.

battleTraits.name: Natural Disaster
battleTraits.effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Mighty Destroyers
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that was not set up this turn to be the target. The target can move up to 3 inches. It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

battleTraits.name: 'Ere We Go!
battleTraits.effect: Your Brutes are not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the third battle round onwards, they can use this ability: set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: A Proper Ruckus
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the 'Mighty Destroyers' ability
regimentAbilities.effect: All friendly units on the battlefield that were not set up this turn are the targets of that ability instead.

regimentAbilities.name: Mega Bossy
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: If your general charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12 inches of your general.

enhancements.name: Armour of Gork
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (6+).

enhancements.name: Trophy Skulls
enhancements.effect: Your general's Control characteristic is 5.

enhancements.name: Amberbone Whetstone
enhancements.effect: The Rend characteristic of your general's melee weapons is 2.

battleTraits.name: Kavalos Lance
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target can pass across enemy models as if it had Fly.

battleTraits.name: Calculated Feint
battleTraits.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly Cavalry units by Retreat abilities.

regimentAbilities.name: Feigned Retreat
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units can use Charge abilities even if they used a Retreat ability in the same turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Reinforced Constructs
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit to be the target. The target has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Mighty Archaeossian
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (5+).

enhancements.name: Murderous Blade
enhancements.effect: Your general's Commander's Blade has Crit (2 Hits).

enhancements.name: Imperious Commander
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 2 inches to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Cold Savagery
enhancements.effect: If your general has not charged this turn and is in combat, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of them to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Shadowmasked
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly Infantry unit that is in combat and did not charge this turn to be the target. Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Murderous Strike
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Infantry units that charged in the same turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Bleed Them Pale
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Infantry unit that is in combat and did not charge this turn to be the target. The target can move 6 inches but cannot end that move in combat.

regimentAbilities.name: Frenzied Exhortations
regimentAbilities.trigger: Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to ward rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Boiling Blood
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12 inches of your general to be the target. Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Save characteristic, halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Bladed Impact
enhancements.effect: If your general charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1 inch of them to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

enhancements.name: Shadow Avatar
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Heralds of Nagash
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.effect: Your unit of Morghast Archai is not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the second battle round onwards, it can use Dread Descent: set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Relentless Discipline
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit to be the target. Make a discipline roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if the target is wholly within 12 inches of your general. On a 4+, pick 1 of the effects below: Your Movement Phase: Add 2 inches to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the phase. Your Charge Phase: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase. Any Combat Phase: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by the target for the rest of the phase. Any Combat Phase: The target has Ward (5+) for the rest of the phase.

regimentAbilities.name: Peerless Cohesion
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Relentless Discipline' ability
regimentAbilities.effect: You can use the 'Relentless Discipline' ability for a second time this phase but you must pick a different target to the one you picked the first time.

regimentAbilities.name: Immaculate Generalship
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to discipline rolls you make.

enhancements.name: Shard Storm
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12 inches of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 7+, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

enhancements.name: Lode of Saturation
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for combat attacks that target this general.

enhancements.name: Mend Constructs
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 6+, Heal (D3) the target.

enhancements.name: Helm of Tyranny
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 12 inches of your general to be the target and roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 3 from the control score of the target for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Awaken the Runes
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.effect: Pick 1 of the ur-gold runes below, then make an activation roll of D6. Each ur-gold rune can only be activated once per battle. On a 1-5, the rune's standard effect applies. On a 6, the rune's enhanced effect applies as well. The effects last until the start of your next turn. Rune of Fury — Standard: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units. Enhanced: In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of your units' melee weapons. Rune of Searing Heat — Standard: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your units' melee weapons. Enhanced: In addition, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of your units' melee weapons. Rune of Fiery Determination — Standard: Your units have Ward (5+). Enhanced: In addition, add 1 to save rolls for friendly units. Rune of Relentless Zeal — Standard: Add 2 inches to the Move characteristic of your units. Enhanced: In addition, add 2 to charge rolls for your units.

regimentAbilities.name: Magmic Tunnels
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly units. Remove them from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Fyresteel Throwing Axes
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick any number of friendly units that are not in combat and are within 10 inches of any enemy units. For each of those units, pick a visible enemy unit within 10 inches of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Too Stubborn to Die
enhancements.effect: Heal (D3) your general.

enhancements.name: Horn of Grimnir
enhancements.effect: Pick your general to use this ability if they are not in combat. Roll a dice for each friendly unit on the battlefield that has any slain models. On a 3+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

enhancements.name: Spirit of Grimnir
enhancements.effect: You can re-roll activation rolls you make for the 'Ur-gold Runes' ability (see Battle Traits).

enhancements.name: Powerful Presence
enhancements.effect: Add 3 to your general's control score.

battleTraits.name: Ply the Skies
battleTraits.trigger: Reaction: You declared a non-Charge Move ability for an Arkanaut Frigate
battleTraits.effect: Used By: The Arkanaut Frigate that is using that Move ability. Pick a friendly Infantry unit that is wholly within the combat range of that Arkanaut Frigate and not in combat to be transported. Remove that Infantry unit from the battlefield. Then, when the Arkanaut Frigate ends its move, set up the Infantry unit on the battlefield again, wholly within the combat range of the Arkanaut Frigate and not in combat. A unit cannot use Charge abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Assault Boat
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
