regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit that was transported this turn to use this ability. That unit can still use Charge abilities later in the turn.

regimentAbilities.name: There's No Reward Without Risk
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a Charge ability for a unit wholly within 12 inches of your general
regimentAbilities.effect: You can re-roll the charge roll for that Charge ability.

regimentAbilities.name: Disengage
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly Arkanaut Frigate to use this ability. If that unit uses a Retreat ability this phase, no mortal damage is inflicted on it and it can still use Shoot abilities later in the turn.

enhancements.name: Masterwrought Armour
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (6+).

enhancements.name: Flask of Vintage Gorogna
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
enhancements.effect: Heal (D6) your general.

enhancements.name: Leave No Duardin Behind
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly Arkanaut Company unit wholly within 12 inches of your general and roll a dice for each slain model from that unit. For each 4+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

battleTraits.name: Fast as Frazzlegit
battleTraits.effect: Friendly units can use Charge abilities even if they used a Retreat ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on friendly units by Retreat abilities.

battleTraits.name: Frazzleboom
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly War Machine is destroyed, before removing it from play, pick an enemy unit within 3 inches of that War Machine and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

regimentAbilities.name: Flankin' Force
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Start of First Battle Round
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly units. Remove them from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

regimentAbilities.name: Glare of Frazzlegit
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the target for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: Sunsteala Shard
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Enemy Shooting Phase
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks while they are wholly within 6 inches of this unit, unless the attacking unit is in combat with the target unit.

enhancements.name: Devious Backstabba
enhancements.effect: Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

enhancements.name: Kunnin' as a Snarlfang
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 12 inches of the bearer.

battleTraits.name: Song of the Hunt
battleTraits.effect: You gain 1 chord each time an enemy quarry is destroyed. The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of chords you have: 1 chord (Simple) — Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units while they are within 9 inches of the enemy quarry. 2 chords (Tuneful) — Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units' attacks while they are within 9 inches of the enemy quarry. 3+ chords (Melodic) — Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units' attacks while they are within 9 inches of the enemy quarry.

battleTraits.name: Target of Vengeance
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect: If there is no enemy quarry on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target. The target is the quarry for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: Airborne Cohesion
battleTraits.effect: Friendly units have a coherency range of 2 inches.

regimentAbilities.name: Leaves on the Wind
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to be the target. The target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase and no mortal damage is inflicted on it if it does so.

regimentAbilities.name: Lifebringers
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
regimentAbilities.effect: Heal (D3) each friendly unit.

enhancements.name: Zephyrkin
enhancements.trigger: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for your general
enhancements.effect: If your general charged this turn, they can move up to 2D6 inches after that Fight ability has been resolved. They cannot end that move in combat.

enhancements.name: Bold Spirit
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units' combat attacks while they are within your general's combat range.

enhancements.name: Cunning Pursuer
enhancements.effect: While your general is in combat, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly units wholly within 12 inches of them. Add 2 instead while your general is in combat with the quarry.

enhancements.name: Head of the Hunt
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's melee weapons while the enemy quarry is within 9 inches of and visible to them.

battleTraits.name: Beast of the Dark Jungles
battleTraits.effect: Pick your general to use this ability if they are in combat. Pick 1 of the following: Gargantuan Jaws: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general and roll a dice. If the roll exceeds that unit's Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain. Roar: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general. Subtract D6 from that unit's control score this turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Predatory Fighters
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Phase, End of Any Turn
regimentAbilities.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with any friendly units. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the unit being rolled for.

regimentAbilities.name: Temple-City Guardians
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Friendly units have Ward (6+) while they are wholly within friendly territory.

enhancements.name: Sotek's Gaze
enhancements.effect: Roll a dice. Add the roll to your general's control score this turn.

enhancements.name: Blade of Realities
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's Relic Celestite Weapon.

enhancements.name: Ancient Strategist
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general. You cannot pick your general. That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

enhancements.name: The Wrath of Chotec
enhancements.effect: The Attacks characteristic of your general's Sunbolt Gauntlet is 6 instead of D6.

battleTraits.name: Reserve Contingent
battleTraits.effect: One of your Mortek Guard units is not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the third battle round onwards, it can use Contingent Arrival: set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3 inches of a battlefield edge and more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Ossiarch Commands
battleTraits.effect: Ossiarch Commands are abilities that can only be used by spending Ossiarch command points. At the start of the battle round, you receive 2 Ossiarch command points. Each Ossiarch Command costs 1 Ossiarch command point to use. The same unit cannot use more than one Ossiarch Command in the same phase. At the end of the battle round, all remaining Ossiarch command points are lost.

regimentAbilities.name: Impenetrable Ranks
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: This is an Ossiarch Command. Pick a friendly unit to use this ability. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to ward rolls for that unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Re-form Ranks
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: This is an Ossiarch Command. Pick a friendly Mortek Guard unit in combat to use this ability. That unit can use a Retreat ability this phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

enhancements.name: Empower Nadirite Weapons
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly Mortek Guard unit wholly within 12 inches of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 5+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Murderous Drive
enhancements.effect: Your general's Soulreaper Scythe has Crit (2 Hits).

enhancements.name: Unstoppable Commander
enhancements.effect: Pick a friendly Mortek Guard unit wholly within 12 inches of your general, then roll a dice. On a 2+, add 3 inches to that unit's Move characteristic this phase.

enhancements.name: Marrowpact
enhancements.effect: Each time your general uses a Fight ability, after all of their attacks have been resolved, Heal (X) your general where X is the number of damage points allocated by those attacks.

battleTraits.name: Constant Flux
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly units while you are the underdog.

battleTraits.name: Arcane Ritualists
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for your general while they are wholly within 6 inches of another friendly unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Cheat Destiny
regimentAbilities.trigger: Reaction: You used a command on a battle tactic card
regimentAbilities.effect: Instead of discarding that card, return it face down to the bottom of your battle tactic deck.

regimentAbilities.name: Predict the Future
regimentAbilities.trigger: Your Hero Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: You can look at up to 3 cards from the top of your battle tactic deck without adding them to your hand. Then, in any order, return each card face down to either the top or the bottom of your battle tactic deck.

enhancements.name: Mutagenic Sorcery
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12 inches of your general to be the enemy target. Then, pick a friendly Tzaangors unit in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target. Roll a D3. On a 2+: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll. You can return 1 slain model to the friendly target.

enhancements.name: Infernal Gateway
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18 inches of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 5+, roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of battle tactic cards you have discarded this battle. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

enhancements.name: Predicted Strike
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general and that is not in combat to be the target. The target can move D6 inches. It cannot move through the combat ranges of enemy units or end that move in combat.

enhancements.name: Fold Reality
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 6+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12 inches of your general and more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Storm Charge
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat. That unit can use Charge abilities this turn even if it used a Run ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Shield of Azyr
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has Ward (5+).

battleTraits.name: Blaze of Glory
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit is slain, make a vengeance roll of D6. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit in combat with that unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Strike Where Needed
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a Retreat ability
regimentAbilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by that Retreat ability. In addition, that unit can still use Charge abilities this turn even though it used a Retreat ability.

enhancements.name: Hallowed Scrolls
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (5+).

enhancements.name: Morrda's Talon
enhancements.effect: Your general's Hallowed Greataxe has Crit (Mortal).

enhancements.name: Quicksilver Draught
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Your general has Strike-first this phase.

enhancements.name: Null Pendant
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
enhancements.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit contesting the same objective as your general. On a 2+, subtract the roll from the control score of that enemy unit this turn.

battleTraits.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
battleTraits.trigger: Once Per Phase, Enemy Movement Phase
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat. That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

regimentAbilities.name: Warpstone-Laced Armour
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability and targeted your Stormfiends unit
regimentAbilities.effect: Your Stormfiends unit has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Endless Swarm of Rats
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: When a friendly Clanrats unit uses its 'Seething Swarm' ability, you can return D6 slain models to that unit instead of D3.

enhancements.name: Skitterleap
enhancements.effect: Make a casting roll of 2D6. On a 6+, remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units. They cannot use Move abilities in the following movement phase.

enhancements.name: Skilled Manipulator
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (4+) while they are within 1 inch of any friendly Clanrats units.

enhancements.name: Scurry Away
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase. If it does so, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

enhancements.name: Cage of Warp Lightning
enhancements.effect: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6 inches of your general and roll a dice. On a 2+, the enemy unit has Strike-last this phase. On a 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on your general.

battleTraits.name: Scions of the Storm
battleTraits.effect: Yndrasta and your Annihilators unit are not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the third battle round onwards, they can use the following ability. Lightning-strike Arrival: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6 inches from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Drive Them Back
battleTraits.effect: Pick any number of friendly units that are both contesting an objective and in combat. Each of those units can make a pile-in move. For each unit that did so, pick an enemy unit within 1 inch of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

battleTraits.name: The Prime Huntress
battleTraits.effect: The Damage characteristic of Thengavar (Yndrasta's spear) is 2D6 for attacks that target a Monster.

regimentAbilities.name: Dazzling Radiance
regimentAbilities.trigger: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
regimentAbilities.effect: Pick your general to use this ability if they were set up this phase. You can return 1 slain model to each friendly unit wholly within 12 inches of your general.

regimentAbilities.name: Strike with the Tempest's Rage
regimentAbilities.trigger: Passive
regimentAbilities.effect: Your general has Strike-first if they charged in the same turn.

enhancements.name: Defend to the Last
enhancements.effect: Friendly units have Ward (6+) while they are contesting an objective you control.

enhancements.name: Hawk of the Celestial Skies
enhancements.trigger: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly units while they are wholly within 12 inches of your general.
